newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool sees scant business, some exceptions.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool sees scant business, some exceptions.

text.p: Most firms reported very little business but there were exceptions and the call for deliveries is still very generally said to be good, trade sources reported from the Bradford wool market on Monday.

The market seems to pay more heed to firmer values in Australia than to weakness in New Zealand. Some market participants wondered whether an easier pound sterling may mean that prospects of a UK interest rate rise soon have receded.
UK prices have been influenced by the strong pound for some months and a check to the currency could bring out business that was delayed while imported wool tended cheaper.
